premises.text: America's cars sit parked most of the day, creating car overpopulation
premises.evidence_span: We have over 250 million cars in America that sit parked 22 hours each day

premises.text: Peer-to-peer marketplace lets people rent nearby owners' cars; owners set price/availability and GetAround takes ~40% with insurance
premises.evidence_span: Owners that pricing and availability, Getaround provides insurance and takes a 40% commission

premises.text: P2P model works beyond dense urban Zipcar-like footprints across the Bay Area and toward national scale
premises.evidence_span: The peer-to-peer model is not limited to dense urban areas like Zipcar

premises.text: iPhone app handles browsing, requests, and smartphone unlock/locate of the car
premises.evidence_span: With it, you can unlock the car and locate the car, all from your iPhone

premises.text: Getaround Car Kit is a low-cost self-install keyless/Wi-Fi/GPS device for secure smartphone sharing
premises.evidence_span: the first ever device designed to securely share access to your car using only a smartphone

premises.text: Berkshire Hathaway insurance deal enables nationwide coverage as part of each rental
premises.evidence_span: we've secured a unique deal with an amazing insurance carrier that will help us expand our coverage across the entire country

value.text: Redefine car ownership via instant nearby car sharing that earns owners money and reduces overpopulation
value.evidence_span: a new way for people to share cars

secondary_value.text: Large-scale sharing would cut CO2 emissions substantially
secondary_value.evidence_span: CO2 emissions would drop by a whopping 48 billion pounds per year

causal_links.evidence_span: Instead of buying a car, you can rent one instantly from someone nearby
Getaround provides insurance as part of each rental

notes: Million-car vision coded only as secondary climate impact, not a premise (§4.1.4). Free Car Kit giveaway excluded as promo. Zipcar comparison supports P3 geographic claim. Commission+insurance in P2; Berkshire national expansion kept as separate insurance-module condition.
